cards.name: Camp GOTR
cards.description: Girls build friendships through creative activities, discussions and movement games. Mornings feature GOTR lessons, and afternoons include traditional summer camp activities.

financial_aid.text: There are ample scholarships available and no girl is turned away from participating in the program due to family finances. The registration page has a self-reporting financial aid section and a pay-what-you-can option.

lunch.text: A healthy snack & lunch at Camp

cards.review_notes: Confirm Christmount's July 13–17, 2027 calendar entry with GOTR: GOTR's own page still lists July 13–17, 2026. The 2027 entry was read through an official search snippet. Grades, hours, lunch and financial aid are retained from the supplied 2026 program page; 2027 details for these fields were not found. Scholarship tiers are stated as percentages, so no calculated dollar tiers are included. The 2026 'registration now open' wording is stale and does not establish current availability or an opening date.
